rules: Study, hypothesis, design, run, attempt, observation, dataset, analysis and finding retain distinct identities.
Every run carries exactly one designPin naming masterRef, designVersionRef and pinKind.
A reusable-design pin is unresolved until registry allocation; promotion preserves derivedFromStudyReleaseRef and every predecessor run pin.
Draft manifests retain draftManifestId; only frozen manifests receive manifestDigest and may be referenced.
Each attempt has one frozen manifest; later manifests carry manifestDeltaFromRunManifest for every declared difference.
Every hypothesis-testing run and manifest pins at least one hypothesis revision.
Prospective status is clock-derived: registration strictly precedes the earliest ResultAccessEvent; later hypotheses are new post-hoc instances.
Attempts use the composite identity experimentRunId plus sequence, monotonic with startedAt, and retain failed attempts under retention controls.
All lifecycle changes record actorRef and authorityRef and all timestamps use RFC 3339 seconds plus explicit offset and clockSourceRef.
Attempt intervals fall within the run interval; completion or abort never precedes start.
Deviations are typed, append-only and scoped to run or attempt; coded not-applicable replaces sentinel values.
RunCoverage records coded absence without copying observations and never converts missingness or censoring to zero or no effect.
successClass and attempt status express orchestration only; a run may complete after all attempts fail and this conveys no scientific result.
Completed and aborted runs are immutable; supersession is an append-only successor link and errata never create or increment run occurrences.
WM-ACT-036 is referenced, not containment-owned; study withdrawal never cascades to evidence-bearing runs.
Effective access equals the strictest contributing design, input and observation classification.
A frozen manifest pins effective interval, digests and canonicalization, secret references only, controlled environment and structured randomness.
reproducibilityGrade derives from manifest completeness and never from run outcome.
Negative, null, no-effect, inconclusive and failed-attempt states remain distinct and belong outside run orchestration state.
Contradictory runs remain independently resolvable and never rewrite design, hypothesis, observations or datasets.
